comment: Endpoints known to speak the OpenAI embeddings shape, offered in the panel
as a starting point. This is data, not code: nothing in this project is
written for one company, and an entry here only saves typing a URL.
Edit it, or point PROVIDER_CATALOGUE at a file of your own.
A wrong base_url is harmless: the panel lists the models from the endpoint
itself before anything is saved, so it fails in front of you.
embedding_pattern says which of the models an endpoint serves are embedding
models, since most serve chat models from the same list and picking one of
those registers a collection that can never be indexed. It is matched
without case against the model name. Leave it out and a generic guess is
used instead. Getting it wrong hides models rather than breaking anything:
the panel offers the unfiltered list whenever the filter leaves nothing,
and always offers to show everything.
